item.title: Evidence for a Young Universe
item.description: In this episode of Sound Theology & Discernment, Justin Peters interviews Dr. Jason Lisle of the Biblical Science Institute about scientific evidence that challenges the billions-of-years narrative and supports a young universe consistent with Scripture. Topics include planetary heat, magnetic fields, spiral galaxies, blue stars, comets, lunar recession, and insights from the James Webb Space Telescope when interpreted through a biblical worldview.

item.title: Job 3, When Words Fail, Lament in the Depths of Suffering
item.description: In Job 3, Job gives voice to profound grief without rejecting God. This reflection on lament shows how sorrow can be brought honestly before the Lord.

item.title: Anchored in the Word: Why Scripture Intake Shapes the Soul
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains why Scripture intake is essential for spiritual stability and a biblical worldview, with simple rhythms for daily Bible engagement.

item.title: Why Adding or Taking Away from God’s Word Is Spiritually Dangerous
item.description: From Eden to Revelation, God warns against altering His Word. Dave Jenkins explains why Scripture is final, sufficient, and authoritative, and why tampering with it leads to deception.

item.title: Job 4, Eliphaz Speaks and the Counsel of Assumption
item.description: In Job 4, Eliphaz responds to Job’s suffering with confident assumptions rather than compassionate wisdom. This episode explains why theology without humility wounds the weary and why Scripture must guide faithful counsel.

item.title: Centering Prayer Examined: Scripture, Silence, and Spiritual Deception
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins examines centering prayer in light of Scripture, exposing the dangers of silence-centered spirituality and calling believers back to Christ and the sufficiency of God’s Word.
